title: FloodGuard Renewal Rate Cap Reductions for Tenure
content:
FloodGuard Private Flood Policy — rate cap grid for renewals.

## Rule

The renewal rate cap percentage of a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy renewal is the tier's renewal rate cap percentage less 7 when the counted tenure is at least 120 months and no flood claim payment was issued on the policy within the 60 months before the date the renewal is recorded; the tier's renewal rate cap percentage less 3 when the counted tenure is at least 60 months but fewer than 120 months and no flood claim payment was issued within those 60 months; and the tier's renewal rate cap percentage otherwise.

"Less 7" and "less 3" are percentage points taken off the tier's percentage. The counted tenure is the tenure counted for the renewal rate cap, in whole calendar months.

## Grid

| Counted tenure | No flood claim payment issued within the 60 months before the renewal is recorded | A flood claim payment issued within those 60 months |
|---|---|---|
| 120 months or more | Tier's percentage less 7 | Tier's percentage |
| 60 months up to 119 months | Tier's percentage less 3 | Tier's percentage |
| Fewer than 60 months | Tier's percentage | Tier's percentage |

## Edges of the grid (hypothetical)

- Counted tenure 120 months, no flood claim payment in the 60 months: less 7. At 119 months: less 3.
- Counted tenure 60 months, no payment in the 60 months: less 3. At 59 months: no reduction.
- Counted tenure 150 months with a flood claim payment issued 20 months before the renewal is recorded: no reduction.
- A flood claim payment issued 61 months before the renewal is recorded lies outside the 60 months and does not bar a reduction.

## In figures (hypothetical)

With a hypothetical tier percentage of 15, the three outcomes are 8, 12 and 15 percent; with a hypothetical tier percentage of 10, they are 3, 7 and 10 percent.
